def prettyPath(resPath):
	    resPath = resPath or ""
	    if resPath.startswith('com.inductiveautomation.perspective/views/'):
	        p = resPath.replace('com.inductiveautomation.perspective/views/', '').replace('/view.json', '')
	        return "views/" + p
	    elif resPath.startswith('ignition/script-python/'): return "scripts/" + resPath.replace('ignition/script-python/', '')
	    elif resPath.startswith('ignition/named-query/'): return "namedQueries/" + resPath.replace('ignition/named-query/', '')
	    elif resPath.startswith('ignition/tags/'): return "tags/" + resPath.replace('ignition/tags/', '')
	    elif resPath.startswith('com.inductiveautomation.perspective/session-scripts/'): return "sessionScripts/" + resPath.replace('com.inductiveautomation.perspective/session-scripts/', '')
	    elif resPath.startswith('com.inductiveautomation.perspective/session-props/'): return "sessionProps/" + resPath.replace('com.inductiveautomation.perspective/session-props/', '')
	    return resPath
	
	def extractPropertyKey(snippet, keyword):
	    if not snippet: return keyword or ""
	    text = snippet
	    idx = text.find(keyword)
	    if idx == -1: return text.strip()
	
	    start = idx
	    while start > 0 and (text[start - 1].isalnum() or text[start - 1] in "._"): start -= 1
	
	    end = idx + len(keyword)
	    while end < len(text) and (text[end].isalnum() or text[end] in "._"): end += 1
	
	    return text[start:end].strip()
	    
	from collections import defaultdict
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger("scanKeywordView")
	
	# Toast so you know the button was clicked
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', payload={'message': 'Button Scan clicked'})
	
	filters = self.view.custom.filters
	rawText = (filters.keyword).strip() 	# Keyword(s) from the view	
	keywords = [k.strip() for k in rawText.split(",") if k.strip()] 	# Turn "foo, bar" into ["foo", "bar"]
	payload = {"keywords": keywords}
	
	projectFilter = filters['projectName'] or 'ALL'
	if projectFilter != "ALL": payload["projectNames"] = [projectFilter] 	# If user picked a specific project, send it to the gateway	
		
	self.view.custom.output = "Scanning..."
		
	logger.info("Requesting scanKeyword for %r in %s" %(keywords, projectFilter))
		
	hits = system.kanoa.devOps.scanKeyword(payload)
	self.view.custom.hits = hits['hits'] or []
	
	if not hits:
	    lines = []
	    lines.append("")
	    lines.append("=" * 70)
	    lines.append("NO RESULTS")
	    lines.append("=" * 70)
	    lines.append("No uses of %s were found in %s." %(rawText, "all projects" if projectFilter == "ALL" else projectFilter))
	    lines.append("=" * 70)
	    self.view.custom.summary = "\n".join(lines)
	    self.view.custom.output = "Scan Completed (no hits)"
	    return
	
	# Build project/path structures
	byProjectCount = defaultdict(int)
	byProjectPaths = defaultdict(set)
	byProjectPathHits = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list))  # project -> path -> [hits]
	
	for hit in self.view.custom.hits:
		system.perspective.print("hit is %s"%hit)
		proj = hit.get("project", "Unknown")
		resPath = hit.get("resourcePath", "")
		
		byProjectCount[proj] += 1
		byProjectPaths[proj].add(resPath)
		byProjectPathHits[proj][resPath].append(hit)
	
	projectsWithHits = sorted(byProjectCount.keys())
	
	# Build report text (same style as console)
	lines = []
	lines.append("")
	lines.append("=" * 70)
	scopeLabel = "ALL PROJECTS" if projectFilter == "ALL" else ("PROJECT: %s" % projectFilter)
	lines.append("%s SCANNER - %s" % (", ".join(keywords).upper(), scopeLabel))
	lines.append("=" * 70)
	lines.append("")
	lines.append("Projects with  hits:")
	for proj in projectsWithHits:
	    lines.append("  - %s" % proj)
	
	totalProjectsWithHits = len(byProjectCount)
	totalHits = len(hits)
	
	lines.append("")
	lines.append("=" * 70)
	lines.append("SUMMARY")
	lines.append("=" * 70)
	lines.append("Total projects with hits: %d" % totalProjectsWithHits)
	lines.append("Total occurrences:        %d" % totalHits)
	lines.append("=" * 70)
	lines.append("")
	lines.append("HITS BY PROJECT")
	lines.append("-" * 70)
	
	for proj in projectsWithHits:
	    count = byProjectCount[proj]
	    lines.append("Project: %s (hits: %d)" % (proj, count))
	
	    paths = sorted(byProjectPaths[proj])
	    for p in paths:
	        pathHits = byProjectPathHits[proj][p]
	        nicePath = prettyPath(p)
	
	        lines.append("  - %s (%d)" % (nicePath, len(pathHits)))
	
	        for h in pathHits:
	            lineNumber = h.get("line", "?")
	            keyword = h.get("keyword", "")
	            snippet = h.get("snippet", "")
	            resourceType = h.get("resourceType", "")
	
	            propKey = extractPropertyKey(snippet, keyword)
	
	            lines.append("      (property key)\t%s" % propKey)
	            lines.append("      line %s [%s%s]: %s" % (
	                lineNumber,
	                keyword,
	                (", " + resourceType) if resourceType else "",
	                snippet
	            ))
	
	    lines.append("-" * 70)
	
	self.view.custom.summary = "\n".join(lines)
	self.view.custom.output = "Scan Completed"
	
	logger.info("scanKeyword returned %d hits across %d projects (scope=%s)" %(totalHits, len(byProjectCount), projectFilter))

from collections import defaultdict, OrderedDict
	
	hits = value or []
	
	#group by project
	grouped = defaultdict(lambda: {"hits": 0, "types": set()})
	
	for h in hits:
	    try:
	        proj   = h.get("project", "Unknown")
	        rtype  = h.get("resourceType", "")
	        snippet = h.get("snippet", "") or ""
	    except AttributeError:
	        continue
	
	    displayType = rtype
	    lower_snippet = snippet.lower()
	    if "tagpath" in lower_snippet:
	        displayType = "Tag"
	
	    g = grouped[proj]
	    g["hits"] += 1
	    if displayType:
	        g["types"].add(displayType)
	
	summary = []
	for proj, info in grouped.items():
	    types_list = sorted(info["types"])
	    if types_list:
	        types_str = ", ".join(types_list)
	    else:
	        types_str = ""
	
	    row = OrderedDict()
	    row["project"] = proj
	    row["hits"] = info["hits"]
	    row["resourceTypes"] = types_str
	
	    summary.append(row)
	
	# most hits first, then project name
	summary.sort(key=lambda r: (-r["hits"], r["project"]))
	
	return summary
